-module(source_fun_lexical_contract).
-export([run/0, make/1, make_shadow/1, make_match/1]).
make(X) -> fun(Y) -> Z = Y + 1, {X, Z} end.
make_shadow(X) -> fun(X) -> X end.
make_match(X) -> fun() -> X = outer, X end.
run() ->
    A = make(10), B = make(20),
    A2 = binary_to_term(term_to_binary(A)),
    B2 = binary_to_term(term_to_binary(B)),
    {10, 4} = A2(3), {20, 5} = B2(4),
    X = outer,
    Shadow = fun(X) -> X end,
    inner = Shadow(inner),
    Match = fun() -> X = outer, X end,
    outer = Match(), ok.
